survivors.claim: FINALISTS' D4 default reads `skip (Recommended) — every tournament dimension was auto-picked` whenever `classifyMenu('framework')`/`classifyMenu('language-runtime')` returns null (no research menu file at all, e.g. a dimension that was `constrained` or picked before research), because the ternary only distinguishes `kind === 'ask'` from everything else. The spec's D4 literally says `else skip`, so this is within the letter of the Decision and the deviations sidecar records the menu-only read, but the printed reason sentence ('every tournament dimension was auto-picked') is false in that case — nothing was auto-picked.
survivors.impact: When the framework was never researched, the owner is told every dimension was auto-picked even though none was; the recommended default is still skip, so no decision is wrongly taken, only the explanation is misleading.
survivors.evidence: Hunk: `const askedDim = ['framework', 'language-runtime'].find((d) => { const c = classifyMenu(d); return c && c.kind === 'ask' })` and `classifyMenu` returns `null` when the menu file is unreadable or has no options. Spec D4: `default: race (Recommended) — <dim> was asked` when the D3 classification of `framework` or `language-runtime` is `ask`, else `default: skip …` — the `else` branch is sanctioned, so this is advisory wording, not a contradiction.
